name: balsanskar
description: BalSanskar — a dedicated platform for Uttar Pradesh Basic Shiksha Parishad schools to record, verify and showcase the work of teachers and the achievements of their students.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @balsanskar/shared build && pnpm -r --filter @balsanskar/api build && pnpm -r --filter @balsanskar/web build
scripts.ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
